Kestrel is a shipping and logistics company that helps move goods around the world. They work with shipping lines (the companies that own the ships) and act as their representatives in different countries.

Here’s a high-school-level explanation:

What Kestrel Global Logistics Does

Kestrel is a company that helps move stuff around the world. They work with big shipping companies and help manage everything when ships arrive at different ports.

In simple terms:

They help ships dock, unload, and get what they need.

They handle customs paperwork so goods can legally enter a country.

They help companies buy and ship products from one place to another.

They make sure shipping runs smoothly and on time.

Where they work:

They have offices in the U.S., the Caribbean, the UK, Asia, and Africa, and partners almost everywhere else. So they really do operate globally.

Why they matter:

Because companies around the world need a reliable way to ship goods. Kestrel basically acts like the behind-the-scenes team that keeps global shipping organized.

Fun fact:

They won a big UK business award (the King’s Award), which is like getting a huge national gold medal for being good at international trade.

How to put a timer of like number counting back from 100 really fast on a tik tok video

To add a fast countdown timer (like counting down from 100 quickly) on a TikTok video, here are a few ways you can do it depending on the tools you're comfortable with:

Option 1: Use a Third-Party Video Editor (Best Quality)

Apps like CapCut (free and made by TikTok), InShot, or VN are great for this.

CapCut Steps:

Open CapCut and start a new project.

Import your video or a blank background.

Tap Text > Add Text, type 100.

Tap the text layer, go to Keyframe tool (diamond icon).

Move the playhead forward a little, change the number to 99, add another keyframe.

Repeat until it reaches 0 (or use copy-paste + edit if you want to speed it up).

Tip: If you're doing it fast (e.g., 100 numbers in 5 seconds), you can keyframe every 2–3 frames.

Adjust text size and position as needed.

Export the video and upload it to TikTok.

Option 2: Create a Timer Using TikTok Effects (Limited)

TikTok doesn’t have a built-in countdown from 100, but you can:

Use a screen recording of a countdown video (from YouTube or a number counter app).

Add it as a green screen overlay in TikTok:

Tap Effects > Green Screen.

Use the video with numbers counting down.

Record your video with the timer playing behind/in front of you.

Option 3: Download a Pre-Made Countdown

Search “Fast countdown from 100 green screen” on YouTube, download it, and:

Use a free video editor (like CapCut) to chroma key the green screen.

Overlay it on your video.

Export and upload to TikTok.

So it’s May 27 and I have some ground beef that was supposed to be frozen by May 23 but I kept in the refrigerator can I still cook it

If your ground beef was supposed to be frozen by May 23 but has just been sitting in the fridge since then, it's likely not safe to eat now—today is May 27, so it's been 4 days past that "freeze by" date.

Here’s why:

Ground beef only lasts 1–2 days in the fridge after its sell-by or freeze-by date.

By Day 4, it's at high risk of spoilage and bacterial growth (like E. coli or Salmonella), even if it doesn’t look or smell off.

Best move? Toss it to be safe. Food poisoning is way worse than wasting a few bucks of beef.

If you’re unsure, you can check for:

A sour or off smell

A sticky or slimy texture

A grayish or brown color throughout (not just on the surface)

But again—even if it seems okay, 4 days is pushing it.
